name: GAN14 MagLev Pro UV 3x3
description: The GAN14 MagLev Pro UV 3x3 comes with all of the amazing features of the GAN14, but with some improvements. This version has an updated anti-pop mechanism that make this issue a thing of the past! Top cubers like Tymon Kolasinski, Matty Inaba, and Leo Borromeo have been getting great results with this updated flagship 3x3, and we hope you will too! This is the UV coated version, which has a glossy outer finish.
